files.tasks.md:
# Tasks
## Fix the reaper
It leaks.
# Notes

steps.line: * Given a notebook with the lines "# Tasks", "## Fix the reaper", "It leaks." and "# Notes" is open

expect.that: .opened.json.sections.notebook | [.drawn[].text | rtrimstr("\n") | select(. != "")] == ["# Tasks", "## Fix the reaper", "It leaks.", "# Notes"]
expect.why: the window shows the notebook's four lines, in order

expect.that:
.opened.json.sections.notebook.length == ("# Tasks
## Fix the reaper
It leaks.
# Notes
" | length)
expect.why: the open notebook holds the whole fixture

steps.line: * And the selection is in "## Fix the reaper"

expect.that: (.opened.json.sections.notebook.drawn[] | select((.text | rtrimstr("\n")) == "## Fix the reaper") | .offset) as $h | .selected.json.sections.notebook.selection | .location >= $h and .location + .length <= $h + ("## Fix the reaper" | length)
expect.why: the selection lies within the line "## Fix the reaper"

steps.line: * When the user chooses View > Fold Heading

expect.that: (.opened.json.sections.notebook.drawn[] | select((.text | rtrimstr("\n")) == "It leaks.") | .offset) as $l | .afterFold.json.sections.notebook.drawn | all(.[]; ((.text | contains("It leaks.")) | not) and (.offset > $l or .offset + (.text | length) <= $l))
expect.why: no paragraph the window shows holds "It leaks."
the text is hidden, not removed

steps.line: * And "## Fix the reaper" shows the folded marker

expect.that: (.opened.json.sections.notebook.drawn[] | select((.text | rtrimstr("\n")) == "## Fix the reaper") | .offset) as $h | .afterFold.json.sections.notebook | any(.folded[]; .offset == $h and (.line | rtrimstr("\n")) == "## Fix the reaper")
expect.why: the heading is marked as folded

expect.that: (.opened.json.sections.notebook.drawn[] | select((.text | rtrimstr("\n")) == "## Fix the reaper") | .offset) as $h | .afterFold.json.sections.notebook as $n | ($n.drawn[] | select(.offset == $h and (.text | rtrimstr("\n")) == "## Fix the reaper") | .rect) as $d | any($n.markers[]; .heading == $h and .rect.width > 0 and .rect.height > 0 and .rect.y < $d.y + $d.height and .rect.y + .rect.height > $d.y)
expect.why: the heading is on screen with a folded marker beside it

steps.line: * And "# Tasks" and "# Notes" are visible

expect.that: .afterFold.json as $s | ["# Tasks", "# Notes"] | all(.[]; . as $t | any($s.sections.notebook.drawn[]; (.text | rtrimstr("\n")) == $t and .rect.width > 0 and .rect.height > 0 and .rect.y < $s.window.content.height and .rect.y + .rect.height > 0 and .rect.x < $s.window.content.width and .rect.x + .rect.width > 0))
expect.why: both top-level headings are drawn within the window
